title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Recording the Issue of a Document and Its Originals
content:
Issuing an approved `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` record does two things at once on the line's books: it charges the issuance fee for the set in force and, on types that have originals, sets those originals in circulation. This page describes that issuing entry and the agent tool that makes it.

## The issuing entry

- **Where it applies.** The issue of an approved document whose cargo has gone on board.
- **Effect.** The document moves from approved to issued and carries the date of issue. One issuance-fee charge for the set in force is added to the documentation account, which raises the documentation charges due. Where the issue puts originals into circulation, they are recorded in the documentation history as put into circulation and added to the originals outstanding on the document.
- **Visible to the customer afterwards.** The document shows as issued, together with its issuance fee and the originals in circulation.

## Invoking `issue_document_with_originals_c9d717be`

This action is the agent's. It becomes available once unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and is then called with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`. One call issues one approved document, dating the issue on the day of the call.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bl_id` | Reference of the approved transport document to be issued, as returned by the transport document lookup for the document number the caller quotes | Text identifier |
| `booking_id` | Booking covered by the document; the booking reference carried on the document record, the same one the booking lookup finds | Text identifier |
| `originals_count` | How many originals of the set in force are put into circulation | Whole number, 0 or more, no decimals, in original documents |
| `issuance_fee_usd` | The issuance fee booked for the set | US dollars with exactly two decimals and no currency sign |

When `originals_count` is 0, the call still issues the document and books the fee, but records no entry for originals put into circulation.

### Return

Success is signalled by one confirmation sentence. It names the issuance-fee entry (an opaque reference beginning "bif_"), the entry for originals put into circulation (a reference beginning "boi_", or the word none when 0 originals were given), the transport document and the booking, the set number, the fee in USD to two decimals, the originals put into circulation and the originals now outstanding. After that the document shows the status issued.

## Basis Q&A

**Does issuing a document with no originals still charge the issuance fee?** Yes. The fee entry is made whether or not originals go into circulation.

**Which set does the issuance fee relate to?** The set in force on the document at the time of issue.
